name: Shuffle strut 909
desc: Sibling flavor: triplet-shuffle four-floor. Elongation-swung hats ([hh@2 hh]), 909 snare instead of clap, walking rim euclid that rotates through 16 positions, and pitched uzu tom pickups masked to phrase ends. Rowdier, more strut than gallop.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.22).lpf(3000), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.6).room(.25), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.42 .22]*4").lpf(sine.range(3000, ${hcut}).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.42, .58).slow(9)), s("rim(3,16,<0 4 8 12>)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.24).pan(.35), s("~ ~ ~ [lt lt mt ht]").speed(${tomspd}).gain(.45).mask("<0 0 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.25).lpf(3200), s("~ sd ~ [sd ~ ~ sd]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.62).room(.25).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.5 .28]*4").lpf(sine.range(4000, ${hcut}).slow(8)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(6000).pan(.6), s("rim(5,16,<0 4 8 12>)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.26).pan(.3), s("~ ~ ~ [lt mt ht ht]").speed(${tomspd}).gain(.5).mask("<0 1 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
